suggestions: I'm grateful for the PR getting approved on the first review, no back-and-forth over nitpicks.
I'm thankful for the azan drifting in through the window right as I was about to doze off at my desk.
I'm grateful for a bug that took three days to find turning out to be one missing semicolon, not a design flaw.
I'm thankful for the mamak still serving maggi goreng at 1am when the craving hits after a late push.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a bonus landing the same week the car needed servicing.
I'm thankful for my dad calling just to ask if I've eaten, nothing more.
I'm grateful for the office aircon finally getting fixed after two weeks of sweating through standups.
I'm thankful for the five minutes of stillness after witir before the day properly starts.
I'm grateful for a teammate quietly fixing the pipeline at 2am so I didn't have to.
I'm thankful for the LRT actually arriving on time when I was already running late for a client call.
I'm grateful for the first sip of teh o ais limau cutting through the humidity on the walk back from lunch.
I'm thankful for a code review comment that taught me something instead of just pointing out a mistake.
I'm grateful for the raya bonus my grandmother still insists on giving even though I've been working for years.
I'm thankful for the thunderstorm that rolled in and gave everyone an excuse to leave the office early.
I'm grateful for a Jumaat khutbah that actually stuck with me past the walk back to my desk.
